verdict.rationale: Paxos documents API-driven movement between USD and stablecoins: a Conversions endpoint for supported assets, mint and redeem orchestrations that convert and transfer in one call, and the Fiat Transfers API for moving USD on and off the platform. Payments also auto-convert to fiat or hold stablecoin balances. Missing for 10: dashboard-based conversion or rebalancing (only a sandbox Fund button is evidenced), explicit internal transfers between platform accounts or profiles, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
